cases.translation: You know that capital oppresses the worker.
cases.explain: Капитал is the grammatical subject of давит (oppresses), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Они не могут выйти из своего скотского ___.
cases.translation: They cannot escape their brutish condition.
cases.explain: The preposition из (out of) governs the genitive case, giving положения.

cases.sentence: Обратился он к Критскому, опять садясь к ___.
cases.translation: He turned to Krítsky, sitting down again at the table.
cases.explain: The preposition к (toward) governs the dative case, giving столу.

cases.translation: You know that capital oppresses the worker.
cases.explain: Работника is the direct object of the transitive verb давит; being an animate masculine noun, its accusative form matches the genitive.

cases.sentence: Продолжал Николай Левин с ___ морща лоб и подергиваясь.
cases.translation: Nikolai Levin continued, wrinkling his brow with effort and twitching.
cases.explain: The preposition с (with) expressing manner governs the instrumental case, giving усилием.

cases.sentence: Если хочешь знать всю мою исповедь в этом ___, я скажу тебе.
cases.translation: If you want to know my whole confession in this regard, I'll tell you.
cases.explain: The preposition в (in) governs the prepositional case, giving отношении.

reading.ru: «Так видишь», — продолжал Николай Левин с усилием морща лоб и подергиваясь.
reading.question: How did Nikolai Levin behave as he tried to explain himself?
options: He struggled, wrinkling his brow with effort and twitching
He refused to speak at all
reading.correct: He struggled, wrinkling his brow with effort and twitching
reading.explain: The text says he continued с усилием морща лоб и подергиваясь — with effort, wrinkling his brow and twitching.

reading.question: What did Nikolai say the new undertaking was?
reading.explain: Nikolai calls it производительная артель — a productive artel.

reading.ru: Он видел, что эта артель есть только якорь спасения от презрения к самому себе.
reading.question: What did Konstantin think the artel really meant to Nikolai?
options: An anchor of salvation from his own self-contempt
A political statement against the government
reading.correct: An anchor of salvation from his own self-contempt
reading.explain: The text says Konstantin saw the artel as only якорь спасения от презрения к самому себе.

reading.ru: Работники у нас, мужики, несут всю тягость труда и поставлены так, что сколько бы они ни трудились, они не могут выйти из своего скотского положения.
reading.question: According to Nikolai, what is the workers' situation?
options: No matter how hard they work, they cannot escape their brutish condition
They are well paid for their labor
They can easily improve their lives
reading.correct: No matter how hard they work, they cannot escape their brutish condition
reading.explain: Nikolai says they cannot выйти из своего скотского положения no matter how much they toil.

reading.question: Where will the new locksmiths' artel be located?
options: In the village of Vozdrem, Kazan province
reading.correct: In the village of Vozdrem, Kazan province
reading.explain: Nikolai answers В селе Воздреме, Казанской губернии when asked where the artel will be.

reading.ru: «И от этого-то вам с Сергеем Ивановичем и неприятно, что их хотят вывести из этого рабства», сказал Николай Левин, раздраженный возражением.
reading.question: What does Nikolai accuse Konstantin and Sergei Ivanovich of resenting?
options: That the peasants are being freed from their slavery-like condition
That the peasants are becoming too rich
That the government is raising taxes
That the artel will fail financially
reading.correct: That the peasants are being freed from their slavery-like condition
reading.explain: Nikolai says it displeases them that peasants хотят вывести из этого рабства — are being led out of this slavery.

reading.question: What did Nikolai shout at Konstantin during his outburst?
options: Told him repeatedly to just leave
Asked him to bring more money
Asked him to fetch Sergei Ivanovich
reading.correct: Told him repeatedly to just leave
reading.explain: Nikolai shouts «Ступай!» ... «И ступай! И ступай!» repeatedly telling Konstantin to leave.

reading.ru: «Я нездоров. Я раздражителен стал», — проговорил, успокаиваясь и тяжело дыша Николай Левин.
reading.question: How did Nikolai explain his outburst after calming down?
options: He said he was unwell and had become irritable
He said he was joking the whole time
He blamed Marya Nikolaevna for provoking him
He denied that anything had happened
reading.correct: He said he was unwell and had become irritable
reading.explain: Nikolai says «Я нездоров. Я раздражителен стал» — I am unwell, I have become irritable.

reading.ru: Я не читал, мрачно сказал Критский, очевидно не хотевший вступать в разговор.
reading.question: Had Kritsky read Sergei Ivanovich's article?
options: No, and he clearly did not want to discuss it
Yes, but he had forgotten it
No, because he had never heard of it
reading.correct: No, and he clearly did not want to discuss it
reading.explain: Kritsky says Я не читал and is described as очевидно не хотевший вступать в разговор.

reading.question: What did Nikolai tell Kritsky to do the next day?
reading.explain: Nikolai tells Kritsky Завтра приходите со слесарем — come tomorrow with the locksmith.

reading.question: What did Marya Nikolaevna say about Nikolai's health?
options: It had never been a concern
reading.explain: She says Здоровье их очень плохо стало — his health had become very poor.

reading.question: What habit of Nikolai's worried Marya Nikolaevna?
options: Drinking vodka, which was harmful to him
reading.correct: Drinking vodka, which was harmful to him
reading.explain: She says Водку пьют, а им вредно — he drinks vodka, and it harms him.

reading.ru: Она девка, а ты барин», — проговорил он, подергиваясь шеей.
reading.question: How did Nikolai describe the difference between Marya Nikolaevna and Konstantin?
options: She is a common girl, and Konstantin is a gentleman
She is more educated than Konstantin
reading.correct: She is a common girl, and Konstantin is a gentleman
reading.explain: Nikolai says Она девка, а ты барин — she is a peasant girl, you are a gentleman.

reading.ru: Живу один в деревне, как жил прежде.
reading.question: How did Konstantin describe his current life to Nikolai?
options: Living alone in the countryside, as before
Living in Moscow with Sergei Ivanovich
reading.correct: Living alone in the countryside, as before
reading.explain: Konstantin answers Живу один в деревне, как жил прежде — I live alone in the country, as I lived before.

reading.ru: Мне кончено, я свою жизнь испортил.
reading.question: How did Nikolai feel about his own life?
options: That it was finished and he had ruined it
That it was just beginning anew
That it had been a great success
reading.correct: That it was finished and he had ruined it
reading.explain: Nikolai says Мне кончено, я свою жизнь испортил — it's over for me, I've ruined my life.

reading.ru: «А ты знаешь, что твой Ванюшка у меня в Покровском конторщиком», — сказал он.
reading.question: What news did Konstantin share to change the subject?
options: That Vanyushka was working as a clerk at Pokrovskoye
That Nikolai's house had burned down
That Sergei Ivanovich was getting married
That the artel had already failed
reading.correct: That Vanyushka was working as a clerk at Pokrovskoye
reading.explain: Konstantin says твой Ванюшка у меня в Покровском конторщиком — your Vanyushka works as a clerk for me at Pokrovskoye.

reading.ru: «Да, но как ни говори, ты должен выбрать между мною и им», сказал он, робко глядя в глаза брату.
reading.question: What did Nikolai insist Konstantin must do?
options: Choose between him and Sergei Ivanovich
reading.correct: Choose between him and Sergei Ivanovich
reading.explain: Nikolai says ты должен выбрать между мною и им — you must choose between me and him (Sergei Ivanovich).

reading.ru: Ей никто, кроме мирового судьи, когда ее судили за то, что она хотела уйти из дома разврата, никто не говорил «вы».
reading.question: Who was the only person to address Marya Nikolaevna formally, as "вы"?
options: The justice of the peace, when she was tried for trying to leave a house of ill repute
reading.correct: The justice of the peace, when she was tried for trying to leave a house of ill repute
reading.explain: The text says only мировой судья addressed her as «вы», when she was tried for wanting to leave a house of disrepute.

reading.ru: Константин с помощью Маши уговорил его никуда не ездить и уложил спать совершенно пьяного.
reading.question: How did the evening end for Nikolai?
options: Konstantin and Masha persuaded him not to go anywhere and put him to bed completely drunk
He left to visit the gypsies as he wanted
He fell asleep at the table mid-sentence
He and Konstantin argued until dawn
reading.correct: Konstantin and Masha persuaded him not to go anywhere and put him to bed completely drunk
reading.explain: The text says Константин с помощью Маши уговорил его никуда не ездить и уложил спать совершенно пьяного.
